title: MIHVER Publication Envelope
description: Machine-readable transport contract for MIHVER's privilege-separated publication architecture (V3.1-A). Produced only by Claude, per docs/development/CODEX_ROLES.md's 'Publication Envelope' section (that document's prose is the semantic owner; this schema is its machine-readable shape). Consumed by the deterministic Local Publication Builder (scripts/dev/publication-builder.mjs) to produce a local commit only -- never a push, never an authenticated GitHub call. The same Envelope shape is also the transport contract for the future privileged Publication Broker (V3.1-B, not implemented by this schema or any code in this task).

remote_name.description: The git remote this identity was read from, normally 'origin'. A literal git remote identifier: every character must be printable ASCII (U+0021-U+007E, so no whitespace/control character, no DEL, and -- unlike a negated-range approach -- correctly excluding every non-ASCII code point including astral ones such as emoji, since JSON Schema regex engines are Unicode-code-point-aware and a negated upper-bound range like [^...-\uFFFF] does not exclude a code point above U+FFFF), no path separator, no ref-like special character anywhere in the value, and must not start with '-'. See Closeout Pack A.2.1, Work Package C. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateRemoteName; a shared parity matrix (including astral cases) is checked by both tests/dev/publication-remote-name-parity.test.mjs and internal/repoidentity/repoidentity_test.go's remoteNameParityMatrix.

owner.description: 1-39 ASCII alphanumeric/hyphen characters, begins and ends with an alphanumeric character, no consecutive hyphens. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateOwner.

name.description: 1-100 ASCII alphanumeric/dot/underscore/hyphen characters; not exactly '.' or '..'; not composed only of '.' characters. Mirrored by internal/repoidentity.ValidateName.

path.description: Repo-relative path, forward slashes, no leading slash, no '..' segment, no NUL/newline.

action.description: 'present' = shape (A) present regular file; 'deletion' = shape (B) authorized deletion. A rename is two entries: old path 'deletion', new path 'present'.

publication_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 hex digest computed per AGENT_POLICY.md's 'Publication Envelope' canonical recipe over exactly allowed_files.

pr_body.description: Required (non-schema-enforced) when pr_expected is true. Verbatim text, or a deterministic template with mechanically-filled fields -- never content Git Operator/the broker composes itself.
